# Mailcraft Studio

> Mailcraft Studio offers free Brand and Content Wizards (Google or email sign-in) plus the Email Marketing Starter Kit: 11 production HTML email templates you brand and fill before pasting into an ESP (Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and other custom-HTML ESPs).

## Primary sources

- [Home](https://www.mailcraft.studio/): Product overview and workflow (sign in → brand → content → ESP)
- [Try free / wizard access](https://www.mailcraft.studio/wizard-access): Free Google or email sign-in for Brand and Content Wizards
- [Email Marketing Starter Kit](https://www.mailcraft.studio/products): Pricing, features, and HTML kit purchase
- [User Guide](https://www.mailcraft.studio/docs): Mailcraft 101 video series (brand apply, product emails, Design Rules, fonts, image stacks, ESP variables)
- [FAQ](https://www.mailcraft.studio/docs/faq): Direct answers on free wizards, branding, ESP upload, Outlook, and kit purchases
- [Blog](https://www.mailcraft.studio/blog): Benchmarks, comparisons, wizard architecture, and ecommerce workflow guides
- [Contact](https://www.mailcraft.studio/contact): Support for wizards, downloads, and order help
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@MailcraftStudio): Mailcraft 101 video series

## Product facts

- Wizards: free with Google or email sign-in (no kit purchase required)
- Product name: Email Marketing Starter Kit (paid HTML zip)
- Template count: 11 production HTML files
- Price: $79.99 USD
- Brand Wizard: apply logo, colors, buttons, footer, and fonts across a zip
- Content Wizard: fill headlines, body, CTAs, and images for one layout; download filled HTML
- Output: ESP-ready HTML (table layouts, inline CSS, Outlook VML button fallbacks)
